Infatuation

By Lee Timberlake

 
(1921)
I
N
 bat black night,

When stars slide low

And look;

Your wet red mouth,

A suckling rose,
        5

Seeks mine

And draws,

Retreats,

Provokes,

Then melts my soul
        10

And moulds it yours.
